Now the X made sense, and she drew it in her notebook with two arms joined in the middle."}],"visual":{"type":"library","id":"chromosome"},"equations":[],"tryTogether":{"question":"Which part holds the two chromatids together?","answer":"The centromere"},"parentPrompt":"Ask your child to draw the X and point to the centromere."}
